The disbelievers among the People of the Book and the idol worshippers were not going to leave their way until clear proof came to them.
The proof was a messenger from Allah, reading pure pages.
In those pages are right and true writings.
And the People of the Book only became divided after the clear proof came to them.
They were only told to worship Allah, being sincere to Him, to be upright, to pray and to give zakat. That is the right religion.
Those who disbelieved among the People of the Book and the idol worshippers will be in the fire of Hell, staying there. They are the worst of creatures.
Those who believe and do good are the best of creatures.

Their reward with their Lord is gardens that last, with rivers flowing beneath them, where they stay forever. Allah is pleased with them and they are pleased with Him. That is for the one who fears his Lord.
